name: Immorality
overview: Scripture defines immorality primarily through the lens of sexual purity, emphasizing the sacred union of marriage as established in Genesis 2:24 where a man and woman become one flesh. Jesus deepens this understanding by teaching that not only the act of adultery but also lustful intent in the heart violates God's standard (Matthew 5:27-28). The Lord also underscores the sanctity of marriage by limiting divorce to cases of fornication, warning against causing or committing adultery through improper remarriage (Matthew 5:32). Ultimately, Jesus teaches that true defilement comes from what proceeds from the heart, highlighting the internal nature of sin beyond outward actions (Mark 7:20).
